epics.title: Report Filtering
epics.description: Allow users to narrow report results using the stated filters.

stories.capability: filter reports by date range, category, and status
stories.benefit: view report results matching selected criteria
stories.story: As a user, I want to filter reports by date range, category, and status so that I can view report results matching selected criteria.
